callees.name: append_event
callees.pre_condition: trace_dir is a writable directory path; event is a dict containing at minimum an 'event_id' field with a non-empty string value and a 'timestamp' field with an ISO 8601 formatted string value.
callees.post_condition: Thread-safely appends the event dict as a single, self-contained JSON line to the events.jsonl file within trace_dir. The persisted record preserves every top-level key from the provided event dict. The call does not modify the event dict.
